title: Topic 19
japanese_text:
A：<u>新婚</u>生活はどう？
B：<u>おおむね</u>順調だけど、思ってたより甘くないかな。家族を養っていかなきゃいけないからさ。相手の連れ子を含めると、みんなで７人の<u>大所帯</u>だから大変なんだ。
english_translation: A: How's the newlywed life? B: It's going well generally, but it's not as easy as I thought it would be. I have to provide for the family. Including my partner's stepchildren, there are seven of us. Supporting such a large household is not easy.
